body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Franklin Electronic Publisher presented its new 12-language speaking global translator ‘TGA-490’ during CES 2007.

It contains over 450,000 words and 12,000 phrases in 12 different languages including Chinese, Korean and Japanese while it also supports recorded human speech with clear pronunciation of words and phrases in all the languages.
Other features include mp3player, currency converter, world clock, alarm and voice recorder.
It supports Mandarin Chinese, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Korean, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese, Russian and Spanish.
It will be available in February.
